orders.thesis: Gapped +34% on 10/29 on what looks like an earnings/guidance beat (volume 5.4M vs ~1M avg), opened 211, ran to 243 and closed at the high. A gap that holds into the close tends to drift up after earnings. Prior 20 days were a steady uptrend, so this was not a one-day spike. No news access, so this rests on price and volume only.

summary: First session, no news access. I scanned the movers. NOW fell 27% on 10/29 on 76M volume, closing at the low. The fall spread to software peers: CRM -4.6%, WDAY -4.4%, TEAM -7.3%, IGV -3.5%. ALNY fell 25% and SFM fell 23%, both closing near their lows. ADT rose 33% on 164M volume, which may be a takeover, but I can't verify that. I bought GKOS at 8% of equity: it gapped up 34% on volume 5x normal and closed at the high, so I'm betting on post-earnings drift. Stop 9%, target 15%, 15-day horizon. I skipped a NOW short because a bounce after a 27% drop is too likely and my conviction was only about 50%. Next session: check how GKOS opened. Look at whether the software selloff continued (NOW, CRM, WDAY) and whether the SFM and ALNY drops kept going. Consider a short on a software name only if it keeps weakening on volume. Keep a log of whether gap-and-hold names drift in the gap direction.
